title: MaxLango content catalog
description: The packs one source offers. An app reads it to install packs and to update them when a version goes up.

format.description: The catalog's own shape. A breaking change ships as a new file (catalog.v2.json) so older apps keep reading this one.

name.description: What the app calls this source.

packs.description: Every pack, in the order a learner should take them within a language.

version.description: Must equal the pack file's own version.

url.description: Where the pack file is, relative to this catalog or absolute (https only).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the pack file's bytes. The app refuses a download that doesn't match.

requires.description: The pack format an app must understand. An app that knows an older one skips the pack.
